name: Stack
summary: Children in a column with one gap from a space role: the layout owns the space, so a view never needs a styled wrapper or a margin. Not for a titled part of a page (use Section) or for items that should wrap in a row.
a11y: A plain `div` with no role: it arranges, it doesn't group for assistive technology.

props.name: gap
props.description: The space between children, by how strongly they belong together: `pair` (a label and its value) up to `section` (parts of a page); `none` when the children own the space between them (LR127).

props.name: measure
props.description: Holds the column to a reading line (size.measure) in a wider view: a short form or list of panels that shouldn't stretch across the screen (LR99). Off by default: the column fills its parent.
